data.name: Van Gogh 3D Paintings
data.detailed_description:
🎮When players click the "Install" button, they can download both the Chinese and English versions of the game simultaneously. By clicking the "Start Game" button, a pop-up menu appears, allowing them to choose to launch either the Chinese or English version of the game.

A Van Gogh art album mode, or book page-flipping mode, has been added, enabling users to browse and appreciate Van Gogh's paintings more quickly.

Every painting by Van Gogh has a detailed article introduction, which is written very well and worth savoring. When approaching Van Gogh's paintings, a voice explanation will play and a detailed introduction of the painting will pop up. The entire process is accompanied by Chinese voiceovers. Van Gogh's classic and famous paintings are all modeled in 3D, allowing players to view them from all angles in 360 degrees. Despite his tumultuous life, Van Gogh's brushstrokes were passionate. With brilliant colors and distorted lines, he depicted the wild fantasies of life. With unrestrained brushstrokes and intense, rich colors, he expressed his boundless love and profound thoughts about life on the canvas. It's truly delightful to enjoy the urban and rural landscapes while appreciating Van Gogh's paintings. Crossing the blue circular portal will lead to the next level. Van Gogh's works are characterized by their vivid, intense and unique colors, such as the interplay of the blue-purple swirling stars and the bright yellow moon and stars in "The Starry Night", and the collision of bright yellow and orange-red in the "Sunflower" series.

Vincent van Gogh (1853 - 1890), a Dutch post-impressionist painter, is renowned for his intense colors and bold brushstrokes. He is hailed as one of the founders of modern art. Born into a Protestant minister's family in the south of the Netherlands, van Gogh had a difficult early life and worked as a clerk, art dealer, and missionary in a coal mine before deciding to pursue painting at the age of 27. Despite his lack of recognition during his lifetime, he only sold one painting, "The Red Vineyard". His works often drew inspiration from nature and life, such as "The Starry Night", "Sunflowers", and the "Self-Portraits" series, using swirling brushstrokes and vivid colors to express his passionate inner emotions. He pursued the purity of art, broke through traditional techniques, and had a profound influence on expressionism in the 20th century. Although his artistic career was short, it was highly explosive. In his early years, he was influenced by Dutch traditional painting and French realism, with a realistic style and dark tones, as seen in "The Potato Eaters", which depicted the hardships of farmers with rough brushstrokes. After moving to Paris in 1886, he was exposed to impressionism and neo-impressionism, and his style changed dramatically, with colors becoming increasingly bright and intense. During his time in Arles, southern France, he created the "Sunflowers" series, using vibrant yellows and oranges to showcase vitality, which became his signature works. Van Gogh's artistic style was unique, with bold and unrestrained brushstrokes and strong color contrasts, often conveying inner passion through exaggerated lines. He was adept at capturing the simple beauty of nature and life, and subjects such as wheat fields, starry skies, and sunflowers were full of vitality under his brush. Despite selling only one painting during his lifetime, van Gogh's artistic achievements have been widely recognized in later generations. His works such as "The Starry Night" and "Wheatfield with Crows" have become classics in art history and have had a profound influence on 20th-century art movements such as Fauvism and Expressionism. In the JD Electrical City, TV merchants directly use van Gogh's "The Starry Night", "Sunflowers", and "White Roses" as the screen savers of televisions, which shows how influential van Gogh's works are and how much people love his paintings.

data.short_description: This is a 3D interactive game introducing all the paintings of the famous Dutch post-impressionist painter Vincent van Gogh. Van Gogh's representative works include "The Starry Night", the self-portrait series, and the sunflower series, etc. He painted a total of 2,051 paintings。
data.supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English*
*languages with full audio support

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon RX 480
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
